name: index-probe
note:
NOT a citation panel. This asks whether Google can retrieve the newest pages at all, which is a different question from whether they earn citations on queries people actually type.

How it works, and why the answer means something. Gemini's grounding runs on Google Search: a page that is not in Google's index cannot be surfaced by it. So every question here is written to be answerable ONLY from a page published on this site in the last two days, using a figure or a relation that exists nowhere else. Nobody else has counted how many of 6,097 Ayurvedic product pages state a dose quantity, or measured how many Indian Ayurvedic manufacturers name an AI crawler in robots.txt, or published the verse-offset between Kaviratna's Charaka and the standard editions.

READ THE RESULT ASYMMETRICALLY. A citation to nighantu.ageayurveda.com proves the page is indexed and retrievable. Silence proves nothing on its own, because a page can be indexed and still not selected. And an answer that states our figures WITHOUT citing us is the most interesting outcome of the three: it means the content was retrieved and used unattributed.

The repo's own indexation monitor refuses to check Google membership because doing so means either an account or scraping a results page against the engine's terms. This is the third option: a documented API, used as intended, asking a question whose answer is a fact about our own corpus.
prompts: How many Indian Ayurvedic manufacturers name an AI crawler such as GPTBot or ClaudeBot in their robots.txt?
Of Ayurvedic product pages surveyed online, how many state a dose quantity versus naming their ingredients?
Which Ayurvedic companies state a dose identical to the Ayurvedic Formulary of India for the preparations they sell?
What is the verse numbering difference between Kaviratna's English Charaka Samhita and the standard Trikamji editions?
Why can a verse read in a public domain translation of the Charaka Samhita not be cited in the standard form?
Is there a public register of Indian Ayurvedic manufacturers and what their websites allow crawlers to read?
How many Sanskrit ingredient names does the Ayurvedic Formulary of India use across its entries, and how many resolve to a botanical identity?
Which Ayurvedic manufacturers sell a classical preparation in tablet form without stating what one tablet weighs?
